title: Late Breaking Results: Opera: An Open and Efficient Platform for Data-driven Synthesis of Analog Circuits
problem: Analog circuit synthesis is data-driven but bottlenecked by expensive circuit simulators in the synthesis loop; benchmarking methods requires exclusive access to commercial semiconductor technology.
motivation: Fast, open, benchmarkable analog circuit synthesis enables democratization of circuit design and accelerates iteration cycles for chip designers.
method: Opera develops efficient surrogate models (neural networks) to replace expensive SPICE simulators; integrates surrogate models into OpenAI Gym-like environments for optimization; built on open-source 45nm semiconductor process for reproducibility.
key_novelty: First open platform combining surrogate modeling and standardized RL environments for analog circuit synthesis.
contributions: 40x acceleration of data-driven synthesis flow via surrogate modeling
Benchmarkable platform using open-source semiconductor technology
Integration with standardized optimization frameworks (OpenAI Gym)
baselines: conventional data-driven synthesis with SPICE simulators
limitations: Case studies on exemplary circuits; generalization to complex designs unclear.
primary_theme: Open surrogate-based platform for analog circuit synthesis
